newsitem.title: USA: Metzler sees Q4 results above estimates.
newsitem.headline: Metzler sees Q4 results above estimates.

text.p: Metzler Group Inc said Monday that it expects to report 1996 fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.11 a share, up from the analyst consensus of $0.10.

Metzler, a consultant to electric and gas utilities and other energy-related businesses, said overhead growth for the quarter was less than earlier anticipated, resulting in the higher earnings per share.
This compares with 1995's fourth quarter pro forma earnings per share of $0.05.

"Billable hours have risen rapidly over the past year, allowing us to spread our fixed costs over greater revenue," said Bob Maher, Metzler's chairman, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
He said the company hired 16 consultants last year and increased both the number and average size of its projects.
Metzler continues to hire consultants and is pursuing one or more acquisitions, in order to fulfill a growing demand for its services.
Shares of Metzler closed off 7/8 to 27-1/2.
